‘Kartavya’ OTT Movie Ending Explained: Does Saif Ali Khan Expose Anand Shri in the End? (Spoiler Alert)
‘Kartavya’ OTT Movie Ending Explained: Does Saif Ali Khan Expose Anand Shri in the End? (Spoiler Alert)
Saif Ali Khan’s 'Kartavya' ends on an intense note filled with betrayal, shocking revelations and a major confrontation. Here’s a closer look at the film’s ending and what happens to Anand Shri in the climax.
Team BTMay 15, 2026, 17:33 IST

Saif Ali Khan’s new OTT release in Kartavya, helmed by Pulkit, who had previously directed Bhakshak on Netflix. Saif marks his return in a cop avatar in this new release, and we personally found him terrific in the movie. Joined by brilliant actors like Rasika Dugal, Sanjay Mishra and Manish Chaudhari, the movie dives deeper into the political scenarios of the country and is a good attempt overall. So, what was the ending of Kartavya like? If you are wondering about the climax of this Saif Ali Khan starrer, we have detailed it right below. Keep reading.

‘Kartavya’ Plot Details

The movie begins with Saif Ali Khan (named Pawan in the series) celebrating his birthday outside a railway station with his team. We’re then informed that Khan’s assigned as the security detail of a reputed journalist who’s arriving to question Anand Shri (a popular Godman with an immense following) regarding the disappearance of kids in his aashram. However, while the journalist is being escorted to her lodging, two gunmen attempt her successful assassination on the same night. Saif’s superior (Manish Chaudhari) questions his failure and decides to suspend him. However, Saif requests him to postpone the suspension for the next seven days, during which he promises to find the culprit.

Next, we are introduced to Saif’s personal life, where his brother has eloped with a girl from a different caste. Saif’s father, who is traditional in his thoughts and against inter-caste marriages, vows to kill him if he’s ever caught. Saif’s wife, played by Rasika Dugal, eventually reveals the location where his brother has been hiding with his new wife. After he visits him, Saif promises to keep them safe and away from the wrath of his father.

The story then shifts focus to a teenage boy who escapes after Anand Shri’s goons attempt to kill him. Saif is later tasked with tracking him down, as the boy is believed to be linked to the journalist’s murder as well. His colleague, Sanjay Mishra (playing Anand in the movie), is by his side throughout. A couple of journalists, in their interaction with Saif, also reveal how Anand Shri has been manipulating innocent kids to commit crimes for him. This raises serious concerns in his mind about the same Godman.

After the child who’s running for his life is caught while escaping on a local bus, Saif takes his custody. He reveals he committed the crime of killing the journalist under the orders of Anand Shri. Saif then ensures that he files an FIR against Anand Shri with the testimony of the child.

‘Kartavya’s Major Spoiler

Now, if you haven’t watched the show yet, this is your cue to stop reading because major spoilers lie ahead. After Saif’s senior, played by Manish Chaudhari, refuses to register an FIR against Anand Shri, he instead proposes a compromise. Under the arrangement, Saif agrees to keep Anand Shri’s name out of the case, while Chaudhari assures that the child’s life will be spared in return. Following this discussion, Saif’s trusted aide, portrayed by Sanjay Mishra, is assigned the task of safely escorting the child to the nearest state border. At the same time, Mishra also advises Saif to move his brother to a house outside the village to ensure their safety.

However, the finale reveals that Sanjay Mishra had been loyal to Anand Shri all along and was secretly working for him from within. He ultimately becomes responsible for the child’s death and is also the one who leaks the location where the girl is hiding with Saif’s brother to her family.

'Kartavya' Ending Explained

During his final confrontation with Mishra, Saif shoots and kills him after uncovering his betrayal. He then goes to meet his father, whom he holds responsible for his brother’s death, and kills him as well. In the closing moments, Saif finally files an FIR against Anand Shri, hinting at the beginning of the latter’s eventual downfall, even if it is not shown directly.

Kartavya, starring Saif Ali Khan, Rasika Dugal, Manish Chaudhari and Sanjay Mishra, is streaming on Netflix from May 15, 2026.
